what: Dover is a diversified manufacturer. It makes refrigeration systems for supermarkets, fuel dispensers and car wash equipment, industrial pumps, marking and coding printers, and components for biopharmaceutical production.
customers: Supermarkets and food retailers, fuel station operators, industrial processors, pharmaceutical manufacturers and waste handlers.
money: vehicle service, waste handling and industrial automation
fuel dispensers, cryogenic components and car wash
industrial pumps, polymer processing and biopharma components
moat: Leading positions in many small niches where it is the standard supplier, with aftermarket parts and service on installed equipment.
risks: Revenue has been roughly flat over three years
Industrial and European demand has been weak
Growth depends partly on continuing acquisitions
Return on invested capital of about 10% is moderate
opportunities: Revenue grew about 4% last year with a 40% gross margin
Biopharmaceutical components and data centre cooling are faster-growing niches
Analysts see about 18% upside from current levels
watch: Organic order growth and bookings in Pumps and Process Solutions.
